# MDL021: mdl-no-root

No model root is declared, or a declared root is not a .grmb file of the walk.

Declare the entry file with `[grimble] models = ["design/model.grmb"]` in grimble.toml (`grimble init` writes it). Reported as a required Unresolved finding, so the gate fails until a root is declared.

## Examples

### MDL021 no model root / A declared empty root list fires #1 (line 6) (fire)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
=== grimble.toml
[grimble]
models = []
```

### MDL021 no model root / A declared root is clean #2 (line 16) (clean)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
=== grimble.toml
[grimble]
models = ["design/model.grmb"]
```
